description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Single and two storey front extensions, Single storey side to rear extension, Two storey side extension, Roof light in front roof slope, External alterations (Demolition of side extension and outbuilding at side)
decision_conditions:
The windows in the northern elevation of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors shall be installed in the elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
